messages:
sam.sales: Heads-up: POC kickoff w/ Acme Corp tomorrow. They want an air-gapped install + a 6-month patch cadence. Need packaging plan + pricing options. 👋

mike.solutions: Are they ok with a ~2GB full installer + 50-200MB delta patches? They mentioned strict bandwidth limits.

anya.eng: We can offer two options: full signed bundle + periodic deltas, or container images with layer diffs. For sealed networks, delta signing + offline activation is required.

linda.security: Security Qs from them: SBOM per release, signed artifacts, deterministic builds, FIPS mode, KMS/HSM for keys. Also need CVE disclosure & response SLA. cc @raj.license

raj.license: License model options: (A) reserved capacity monthly (GPU-based) with offline seat token; (B) perpetual + annual support. Airgapped packaging/signing = one-time engineering fee. I can draft numbers.

ben.eng: Re upgrades: recommend staggered rollout: staging -> canary -> prod. Canary in an airgapped environment means pre-signed canary images + a small rollback tool we ship.

sam.sales: They also want an upgrade blackout window (quarterly) and ability to postpone patches up to 45 days. Is that acceptable?

anya.eng: Yes. We can build cumulative offline patches. Note: if they defer >6 months we recommend a rebase (full installer) to avoid large delta chains.

linda.security: Deliverables we need to provide: SBOM, signed manifest with sha256 sums, upgrade runbook, integrity verification steps, and offline attestation guidance for agent signatures.

build-artifact-bot: bundle-builder: bundle-20260210-1 signed, size=1.9GB, sha256=3f7a9b... (placeholder)

mike.solutions: For the POC propose: 1) one-time full bundle + runbook 2) monthly delta patches 3) 24/7 support SLA 4) sample pricing line: POC eng fee + monthly reserved price.

sam.sales: Can we confirm timelines to enable signed delta pipeline + HSM signing? They need security questionnaire answered by EOW.

anya.eng: HSM/KMS integration ~2w to enable with our KMS connector + 1w testing in CI. Delta pipeline automation ~3w to create + sign deltas automatically.

raj.license: I'll prepare two pricing quotes: with and without eng enablement. Will call out compliance add-ons (FIPS validation, pentest).

linda.security: If legal needs 3rd-party attestation we can provide SOC2 + key custody notes. Also include revocation process for a compromised signing key.

ben.eng: Ops note: customer wants canary behind strict firewall w/ only outbound to their private repo mirror on port 443. We'll need IP allowlist, cert pinning, and mirror sync docs.

sam.sales: I'll ask them for allowed egress ranges and whether they require notarization beyond our signature.

anya.eng: Also: quantized model bundles reduce size but require model-verification steps. We'll include a lightweight inference smoke test and checksums for each model artifact.

sam.sales: :thumbsup: I'll send this plan to Acme and request the security questionnaire deadline + any legal constraints.

linda.security: One more: define revocation + emergency patch path (airgap hotfix process) in the runbook.

mike.solutions: I'll draft a short POC scope doc + pricing table after the call. Ping me for numbers.

sam.sales: Thanks everyone — I'll update after the kickoff. /cc @legal if they want to jump in.
